verdict.rationale: Mailchimp ships built-in AI. Its pricing page lists 'Generative AI features', and Analytics AI (part of Mailchimp with Intuit Intelligence) explains which campaigns drive revenue and gives recommendations grounded in store data. However, the evidence shows advisory and insight AI rather than an in-product assistant you can hand tasks to. The 'create campaigns without leaving the chat' claim refers to external AI tools, not a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: evidence of an in-product assistant that takes delegated tasks (e.g., building or sending campaigns or automations on request), detail on what the generative AI features do, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
